goal: Scaffold a Next.js application with Tailwind CSS configuration and port 3011 scripts.

steps.instruction: Check if the workspace is empty or contains existing project files.
Create package.json with Next.js, React, Tailwind dependencies and scripts running on port 3011.
verify: grep -q '"dev": "next dev -p 3011"' package.json && grep -q '"start": "next start -p 3011"' package.json

steps.instruction: Create Tailwind and PostCSS configuration files.
Create the initial App Router layout and page files.
Verify that package.json declares Next.js and scaffold files exist.
verify: cat package.json | grep -q '"next"' && test -f tailwind.config.js && test -f app/layout.js
